messages:
Iris: quick UX check — on narrow phones the rightmost table overflow chevron collides with the bottom-right sidebar 'drawer' handle. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/drawer-collision.png :confused:
Kai: which phones? reproducible steps?
Iris: repro on iPhone 12 mini and older Androids (~360w). Open table, long ID column scrolls horizontally. The chevron sits ~12px from edge and the drawer handle sits over it. Users accidentally open drawer when trying to tap chevron.
Noah: saw increased "open drawer" misclicks in funnel for mobile last 48hrs. That aligns.
Zoe: accessibility note: overlapping controls create ambiguous focus targets for keyboard users. Also the chevron tooltip is read as "More" which is vague — should be explicit for screen readers.
Kai: proposal: at <=400px scope drawer handle to a 10px visible stripe but provide a large invisible hit-area via ::after so touch target remains >=44px. Also shift the overflow chevron left by 20px when it detects adjacent interactive handle.
Iris: prefer the shifted chevron + smaller visual handle. Add a subtle stroke so the handle is discoverable.
Alex: copy change: change chevron tooltip from "More" -> "Show row actions" and drawer handle aria-label -> "Open drawer". Keeps things clear for mobile.
Kai: CSS test patch:
```css
@media (max-width:400px){
  .drawer-handle{width:10px; right:env(safe-area-inset-right); background:linear-gradient(...);}  
  .drawer-handle::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-17px;width:44px;height:44px}
  .table-row .overflow-chevron{transform:translateX(-20px)}
}
```
Zoe: ok but ensure the handle is reachable via keyboard — add an offscreen focusable button in header for keyboard users. Also update screen reader text for chevron to "Show row actions".
Kai: adding behavior: detect .has-h-scroll and add `.overflow-shift` class so we only nudge chevrons when needed. Will try on staging.
Iris: can we also make the chevron tap area larger on mobile (padding) to reduce misses?
Kai: yes, will add 8px touch padding and include a test for TalkBack/VoiceOver.
Noah: schedule short 10m validation tomorrow after deploy? 10am PT works.
touchbot: ci note — mobile-touch-tests added to nightly (build 2026.04.02-07).
Kai: opened WIP PR: https://git.redwood/PR/4422 — includes CSS, aria updates, copy tweak.
Iris: thanks — leaving two annotated variants in the design doc and linking the token request for the handle color.
Zoe: post-change checklist: VoiceOver quick pass, TalkBack quick pass, keyboard tab order check. I'll coordinate.
Alex: ship copy tweak with the same PR if staging looks good. :+1:
